fields.Name: C3 -> S9.5
fields.Description: Gate G3.10 (owner PR 4, phase 3, dataset C3, criterion S9.5): on C3 (W9-multiclass s42) SemanticsCheck passes for 3 of 3 classes (Attended, Cancelled, NoShow; NoShow adverse): each class sits at its artifact's class-order position, the At-Risk list sorts by adverse probability and its label names every adverse class and no other; and a binding that swaps the adverse class is refused, 1 of 1: the at-risk-list row loaded as an entity through MJAPI with its Label set to a non-adverse class is refused on Save() with a validation error on Label, and the row is unchanged. The model is trained with logistic regression under a seeded 25% holdout and evaluated through the lifecycle gate, which creates its four MJ: ML Output Bindings rows. Mutation: remove the adverse-class comparison in Core semantics-rules.ts (labelProblem) -> swapped binding refused 0 of 1.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: SemanticsCheck passes for 3 of 3 C3 classes; a binding that swaps the adverse class is refused, 1 of 1.
